text: Rayan Roshan is a Computer Science student based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
Rayan is studying Computer Science at Toronto Metropolitan University.
Rayan’s academic focus includes software engineering, systems, artificial intelligence, and applied problem solving.
Rayan follows a personal philosophy of keeping systems simple, functional, and focused on real-world impact.
Rayan builds practical software solutions using Swift, Firebase, and AI, with a strong emphasis on clean code, user experience, and scalability.
Rayan’s core technical interests include full-stack development, mobile development, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
Rayan’s programming languages include JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Swift, HTML, and CSS.
Rayan has experience building frontend applications using React, React Router, Framer Motion, and modern CSS techniques.
Rayan has backend experience using Node.js, Express, Firebase, Azure services, and RESTful APIs.
Rayan has worked with AI tools including OpenAI APIs, Google Gemini, vector embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM chaining, and fine-tuning.
Rayan regularly uses Git, GitHub, VS Code, Figma, Docker, ESLint, and cloud deployment platforms such as Vercel and Azure.
Rayan is the founder and iOS developer of Univ, an admissions platform designed to help students navigate post-secondary applications.
Univ was built using Swift for iOS development, Firebase for backend services, Gemini AI for intelligent features, and Azure for cloud infrastructure.
Rayan began building Univ in 2023 and delivered a functional MVP in under four months.
Rayan participated in entrepreneurship programs including the Digital Media Zone and Innovation Boost Zone, where he scaled Univ with grants and cloud credits.
As a Software Engineering Resident at Headstarter, Rayan built multiple AI, machine learning, and full-stack projects using JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Vercel.
Rayan serves as a Project Experience Lead at TMU BYTE, where he designs AI and machine learning roadmaps and mentors contributors to deliver showcase-ready projects.
Rayan is an incoming ServiceNow intern at Ernst and Young, where he will configure and test ServiceNow modules and support technical documentation.
Rayan built an AI customer support agent supporting real-time voice and text interaction, live transcription, and context-aware responses using Gemini and vector embeddings.
Rayan developed a property recommendation system in Python that identifies comparable properties using feature similarity and statistical analysis.
Rayan worked on a multimodal video analysis system that enables users to chat with videos, generate timestamps, and search scenes using NLP and computer vision.
Rayan built an AI system to extract healthcare information and automatically fill prior authorization forms.
Rayan contributed to research analyzing child care accessibility for immigrant families in the Greater Toronto Area using large-scale data.
Rayan is the founder and engineer behind AskCents, a personal finance coaching platform featuring an AI chatbot and gamified rewards.
Rayan co-founded Yapp, a real-time social platform for Toronto Metropolitan University students focused on messaging and event coordination.
Rayan’s soft skills include communication, teamwork, leadership, adaptability, problem solving, and time management.
Rayan enjoys learning new technologies and continuously improving his technical and product development skills.
Rayan maintains a personal portfolio website, multiple GitHub repositories, and a professional LinkedIn presence.
Rayan can be contacted through the contact form available on his personal website.
